result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly overall. The only notable defects are minor cosmetic issues: the promo banner's decorative graphics extend beyond its rounded container edges, and the delivery-fee amounts visually run together with the word 'delivery'. Excluded per instructions are the partially visible horizontal carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative background circles overflow past the rounded corners of the green card, creating visible circular edges outside the banner's rounded boundary.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes to the banner's rounded container, or apply overflow: hidden so the artwork stays within the rounded corners.

issues.description: The delivery-fee text uses the symbol '€0.90 delivery' with no space between the currency amount and the word 'delivery' (e.g., '€0.90delivery'), which reads as run-together text.
issues.suggestion: Add spacing or a separator so the amount and label are visually distinct, e.g., '€0.90 delivery' or '€0.90 delivery fee'.
